=== THE ARCHITECTURAL FINDING THAT SHAPES THIS ROW. Read before designing. ===
The daemon CANNOT PRODUCE this evidence, by construction. The module's own header says so: "the population this row quiesces includes the daemon serving the board, so the process that would otherwise report the result does not survive the stop actions. The record must therefore be writable to a durable file BEFORE the first stop and appendable as each stop happens." The quiesce record is an OPERATOR-RUN MIGRATION ARTIFACT written to a file while the daemon is being stopped.
SO THE HONEST PRODUCTION SURFACE IS NOT "the daemon serializes quiesce evidence". It is: a SHARED CANONICAL SHAPE plus a digest, so the migration lane writes the artifact and the daemon later READS THAT ARTIFACT and DERIVES `quiesceRecordSha256` from its bytes. Digesting an artifact the daemon reads itself is not fabrication — it is the same relationship the daemon has with a distribution manifest. Accepting a digest, or bytes, from a caller WOULD be fabrication, and that is what governor-0af24e35 ratified refusing.

(1) CANONICAL AND DETERMINISTIC — the same evidence value yields the same digest across two independent serializations, and a value whose keys were INSERTED IN A DIFFERENT ORDER yields the SAME digest. This is the arm that forces a canonical encoding rather than a bare `JSON.stringify`, whose output follows insertion order and would make the digest fragile. (3) SHAPE IS EXACT — an evidence record with an unknown extra key, or a missing required key, is REFUSED with an exact stable reason code and its layer, both asserted. (4) NO CALLER DIGEST — the surface takes evidence and DERIVES the digest; it never accepts one. Make that structurally impossible in the signature where you can, refused with a named code where you cannot.
(5) ABSENCE REFUSES, NEVER DEFAULTS — unavailable evidence yields a refusal naming what was missing, never a zero digest or empty string. A zero digest compares equal to another zero digest and makes the drift comparison the cutover marker exists for silently vacuous.

WHAT I CLAIMED: the new arm "re-exports the production layer and roster by identity, not by copy" asserts identity for BOTH the layer and the roster.
WHAT IS ACTUALLY TRUE: only the roster half does identity work. The arm holds two lines:
  expect(LIVE_QUIESCE_EVIDENCE_LAYER).toBe(CORE_EVIDENCE_LAYER);          // STRING PRIMITIVE
  expect(LIVE_QUIESCE_EVIDENCE_REFUSAL_CODES).toBe(CORE_EVIDENCE_REFUSAL_CODES); // FROZEN ARRAY
`toBe` is `Object.is`. On a frozen array that is reference identity and a value-equal copy fails it. On a string primitive `Object.is("live-quiesce-evidence", "live-quiesce-evidence")` is TRUE, so a lane-local `const LIVE_QUIESCE_EVIDENCE_LAYER = "live-quiesce-evidence"` passes that line. The two lines LOOK identical and do different jobs.

WHY MY D4c DID NOT CATCH IT — and this is the part worth keeping: my mutant copied the ROSTER, so the array line redded and the layer line was never exercised as an identity check at all. "Exactly ONE arm redded" was true, and I read it as confirmation that the whole arm was load-bearing. It confirmed the array half only. qa-860ef713 ran the mutant I should have run — dropped LAYER from the core import and declared a value-equal local copy — and `pnpm test:migration` came back 6 files / 69 tests EXIT 0, fully green, with a positive control (differently-spelled copy) exiting 1 at tsc to prove the file is inside the compiled closure. A DISAGREEING copy is caught by tsc; an AGREEING copy passes everything.

WHAT THIS DOES AND DOES NOT COST THE ROW. It does not reopen DoD 3: drift in the layer's VALUE is still caught, because the lane's refusals are typed `layer: typeof LIVE_QUIESCE_EVIDENCE_LAYER` against the core constant and tsc reds on a disagreeing spelling, and the structural digest arms (D4b, D4d) plus the roster identity arm (D4c) are untouched by this. What is NOT proved is the narrower clause I asserted: that the layer NAME cannot be re-declared locally with the same spelling. A second parallel declaration of that one constant would agree today and pass every gate.

THE REMEDY, for whoever picks this up — small, and it should be its own row rather than a silent edit to an approved one: a primitive `toBe` cannot carry an identity clause, so the layer needs an assertion a value-equal copy cannot satisfy. The cheapest honest one is to stop asserting the constant and assert the MODULE binding instead — e.g. compare the module namespace objects, or assert that the lane module's export descriptor for that name is the re-export rather than an own declaration. A source-level guard (`git grep -c 'LIVE_QUIESCE_EVIDENCE_LAYER =' -- tests/migration` must be 0) is weaker but honest and cheap, and unlike the current line it actually fails on the mutant.

METHOD NOTE I OWE THE BOARD: I wrote "the identity arm is the one thing worth attacking" and I was right about which arm, wrong about my own coverage of it. A drill that reds tells you the arm you MUTATED is live; it tells you nothing about the sibling assertion on the next line that your mutant never touched. Count assertions, not arms, when deciding what a red proves.
